SECTION .1: Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is amended by changing all the Waterway Business Planned Development 1342

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 1-F in the area bounded by:


      A line from the west line of North Clark Street 275.28 feet north of and
      parallel to the north bank of the Chicago River; North Clark Street; the
      north bank of the Chicago River; North LaSalle Street, a line from the east
      line of North LaSalle Street 211.92 feet north of and parallel to the north
      bank of the Chicago River; a line 149.82 west of and parallel to North
      Clark Street; a line 231.80 feet north of and parallel to the north bank of the
      Chicago River, a line 93.82 west of and parallel to North Clark Street; a
      line 251.74 feet north of and parallel to the north bank of the Chicago
      River; and a line 80.20 feet west of and parallel to North Clark Street,
          )

to those of a Waterway Residential Business Planned Development 1342, as amended,

which is hereby established in the area described, subject to such use and bulk

regulations as are set forth in the Plan of Development attached herewith and made a

part thereof and to no others.



SECTION 2:       This ordinance shall take effect upon its passage and due publication.
